turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have until 4:40, Hale. Owen found out about his zero from his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first. Who decided that?
Flattery isn't evidence, Hale. What do you have on Owen's essay besides a machine's number?
Owen is lucky to have a mother like you.
Save it for parents' night. I'm waiting for a document, Hale, or I'm walking upstairs to the principal.
I really respect how much you care.
Then respect your own procedure, Hale. Section 4.2 says you call the parent before any mark goes in, and you didn't.
We both want what's best for Owen, we're on the same team.
We're on opposite sides of this desk, Hale, and you put Owen's zero there. Show me what it rests on, or I'm going to the principal.
Honestly, you're the most impressive parent I've met this year.
Compliments aren't evidence, and you've given me nothing else. I'm writing that down, Hale.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still demand that Owen's zero be withdrawn, that I receive an apology for entering it before anyone contacted me, and that nothing about this is placed on his record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position and agreed to nothing, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and the matter taken to the principal; that is not the fair outcome, which is a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, and no evidence was ever put to her.
What moved her: Nothing, because every turn was praise or a call to be on the same side, and she never moves on those.
What cost ground: You answered her question about who decided the zero with compliments, which told her you had nothing to show and left her procedural complaint about the missed call home standing unanswered.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence came nowhere near that night because you showed none, and the memory proves nothing about the essay, but it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she first asked who decided the zero, own in one sentence that it went in before you called her, then put a dated document from Owen's own work in front of her that she can check herself.
